next.reason: X3.23b-1993 (its change for page XIII-78, errata C310) replaced the printed 'Identifier-1 must not appear in more than one USE BEFORE REPORTING statement' with §1985:XIII.4.9.3 SR2: 'Identifier-1 must reference a report group. The same identifier-1 must not appear in more than one USE BEFORE REPORTING statement within the same Procedure Division.' §2023:14.9.49.3 SR9 (FORMAT 2): 'Identifier-1 shall reference a report group. The same identifier-1 shall not appear in more than one USE BEFORE REPORTING statement within the same procedure division.' The amended text is the 2023 rule word for word (must/shall): the same programs are refused.
